title: 629. Erect the Fence

examples.explanation: These five points wrap all trees; interior points stay inside.
All three lie on one line, so all belong to the boundary.

hints: Sort points and build the convex hull; points lying on hull edges count as boundary too.
After finding hull corners, scan every input point for collinearity with each hull edge and keep those between the endpoints.
Compare squared distances to avoid floating point; order of the answer does not matter.
Adaptation: the nested output maps to int_list_2d in this judge.
